uiuc.patchNote: 2026-27 international tuition & fees range $42,248-$53,078 by major (value = low/base end; Engineering/Business etc. higher). UIUC publishes no English-test minimums, only admitted-student typical ranges (TOEFL 105-112, DET 135-145, IELTS 7.5-8) - left blank.

ucsd.patchNote: TOEFL 83 applies to tests before Jan 2026; new TOEFL scale minimum is 4.5 (from Jan 2026). All required minimums. Tuition: 2026-27 entering cohort, per quarter tuition $4,734 + student services $462 + NRST $13,090 + campus fees ~$821 (x3 quarters) ~= $57,380/yr; excludes mandatory health insurance ($3,195/yr, waivable) and one-time fees.

ucd.patchNote: UC Davis defers to UC-system minimums (UC official site). TOEFL 80 for tests before Jan 2026; new scale 4.5. UC notes a campus may require higher for selection.

gatech.patchNote: Georgia Tech's page defers to University System of Georgia approved methods; these are USG system minimums (TOEFL 69 pre-2026 / 3.5 new scale; IELTS 6). GT publishes no higher number. Duolingo does not satisfy USG requirement. Tuition: 2026-27 international tuition $35,610 + mandatory fees $1,716.

osu.patchNote: 2026-27 Columbus international tuition incl. instructional/general fees, nonresident surcharge and $3,103 international undergraduate fee.

utaustin.patchNote: Required minimums from UT Admissions international FAQ.

nyu.patchNote: NYU has NO minimums; 100+ TOEFL iBT (tests on/before Jan 20 2026; 5+ on new scale) is the published 'competitive' recommended score. IELTS/DET competitive scores not confirmed.

rutgers.patchNote: Tuition: 2026-27 NB non-resident tuition $36,831 + fees $4,008 (international pay same; +$500 SEVIS fee, insurance extra). Acceptance: Fall 2023 CDS (latest published on Rutgers OIRAP) 28,326 admitted / 43,347 applied. SAT: CDS 2023-24 leaves composite blank; value = sum of section 25th/75th (ERW 630-720, Math 640-760) for enrolled students, approximate. Admissions site's fall-2026 admitted mid-50 by school: SAS 1380-1520, Engineering 1400-1520, Business 1390-1510.

purdue.patchNote: Fall 2025 overall admission rate 43.4% of 86,953 applications (in-state 71%, out-of-state 39% per Purdue newsroom).

kcl.patchNote: IELTS: Band B (7.0 overall, 6.5 each) covers most UG faculties; Band D (6.5) for many Natural/Mathematical/Engineering Sciences courses. Living: 2026-27 average £1,770/month x 9-month UG year = £15,930 (KCL range £11,979-£21,078; 12 months = £21,240). Tuition not confirmed (course pages only).

ucl.patchNote: IELTS: Level 1 (formerly 'Standard') = 6.5 overall, 6.0 each; many UCL programmes require Level 2 (7.0) or higher - course-dependent. Tuition and living not confirmed (UCL pages blocked fetch).

edinburgh.patchNote: Living: 2026-27 average £1,546/month = £13,914 for 39-week academic year (£18,552 full year). IELTS: standard 6.5 overall (5.5 each); Business 7.0, Nursing/Social Work higher. Tuition not confirmed (degree finder behind login redirect).

oxford.patchNote: 2026 entry overseas annual course fee £37,380-£62,820 (midpoint £50,100; clinical Medicine higher). No separate college fee: the single course fee covers University and college services. Living 2026: £1,405-£2,105/month, £12,645-£18,945 for 9 months.

imperial.patchNote: IELTS: standard level 6.5 (6.0 each); higher level 7.0 for some courses. Living: 2026 UG average range £16,392-£17,042 per 9-month academic year (value = midpoint).

manchester.patchNote: Living: 2026/27 first-year UG estimate £14,840 for 41-week year (£15,030 self-catered). IELTS not set: Manchester states UG requirements 'usually IELTS 6.0-7.0', course-dependent, no single standard.

warwick.patchNote: IELTS not set: Warwick uses bands (A 6.0, B 6.5, C 7.0) by course with no stated standard.

lse.patchNote: IELTS 7.0 overall (high component minimums) for most UG programmes. Living: LSE publishes 'at least £1,550 per month' only; value = £1,550 x 9 months (derived; 12 months = £18,600).

bristol.patchNote: Living: Bristol publishes 2025/26 UG average £1,401/month only; value = x9 months (derived; x12 = £16,812). IELTS not set: course-specific 'profiles', no single standard.

glasgow.patchNote: IELTS 6.5 (no subtest below 6.0) is the standard UG requirement per search snippet from gla.ac.uk English language page; some courses higher. Living: Glasgow publishes £1,100-£1,700/month (Aug 2026); value = midpoint £1,400 x 9 months (derived).

nottingham.patchNote: Living: Nottingham publishes 'around £800 to £1,200 per month' incl. accommodation; value = midpoint £1,000 x 9 months (derived). IELTS not confirmed on a citable page (course-specific).

leeds.patchNote: 2026/27 average for 39-week academic year (range £6,670-£18,170; 52 weeks avg £16,640).
